content:
Maya: Heads-up — after last night's RBAC role-matrix change, viewers are intermittently getting 403s when the Console requests project KMS envelopes. Anyone else seeing this?
Aj: Yep, seeing it in prod for a few orgs. Roughly 18% of key fetches failing. Logs show `access_denied: missing permission redwood.kms.decrypt`.
Oliver: That's unexpected — Console should be using console-runner service account to call KMS. Did the binding migration accidentally change the scope for that SA?
Priya: I checked audit logs. role-change events around 03:12 UTC from job migrate-rbac-2026-03-19. The binding for `serviceAccount:console-runner` moved to workspace scope instead of project scope for several projects.
sec-bot: ALERT: Privilege regression detected for principal console-runner. Sample log ids: abc123, def456. Tagging eng-security.
Maya: Can we revert the migration quickly? deploy-bot, is there a rollback path scoped to just the binding changes?
deploy-bot: We have a rollback script. ETA ~20m pending on-call approval. Example command: ```./migrate-rbac rollback --job migrate-rbac-2026-03-19 --only-bindings```
Aj: Short-term hotfix idea: re-add `kms.decrypt` to console-runner at project scope for impacted projects via a targeted binding, then revert migration after root cause fixed. I'll open a PR for the binding patch + a QA flag to disable the stricter UI gating.
Oliver: Also add e2e test: viewer -> open project -> attempt KMS decrypt path. Add a telemetry event on decrypt failure so we can track per-org.
Priya: From the user side we have customers getting toasts: "Permission denied" when opening keys. I'll draft a status message for Support and Prep a list of impacted orgs from the audit ids.
Maya: Aj, please create the PR. Oliver, coordinate tests and smoke plan. Priya, ping support for customer comms and list. Tom, want to sanity-check the UI gating logic?
Tom: Quick glance — I noticed one gating check in console-ux that used `hasPermission('project.edit')` instead of `hasPermission('project.view')` which could invert viewer/editor logic in edgecases. Might be related.
Oliver: Good catch. I can fix that small predicate in the same patch to avoid another rollback.
Aj: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1234 — adds explicit project-scope binding for console-runner and a fallback so the UI will try org-level decrypt if project-level fails.
Maya: Plan of action: 1) hotfix deploy to Canary 2) smoke tests on 5 orgs 3) if good, deploy to Prod 4) rollback migration job 5) monitor audit logs and error rate 6) postmortem. Any objections?
Priya: No objections. I'm drafting the status note and will include impacted org list.
Aj: Deploy started to Canary. Rolling back binding migration in parallel if canary looks good.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy succeeded. Monitoring shows decrypt error rate down to ~0% in canary orgs.
Aj: Prod deploy complete. Metrics: KMS decrypt errors dropped from 18% -> 0.8% over last 10m.
sec-bot: Follow-up checklist: - add RBAC e2e test for decrypt path, - emit audit event for migration operations, - alert if decrypt failures >5% for 5m, - run sampling on previous migration job for scope drift.
Maya: Thanks team. We'll run a short postmortem tomorrow and add the checklist to the incident ticket. Priya, attach sample audit ids + PR + timeline.
Priya: On it. I'll create the incident ticket with timeline and attach logs and the PR link.
Maya: Great. Closing this thread for now — update the ticket with any new findings. :white_check_mark:
